name: Ikka Ryouran (Netori no Houshuu)
original_name: 一家繚乱(寝取りの報讐)
source:
While a husband worked abroad, his own son cuckolded him by having sex with his wife. 
The husband turned his eye to his son's beloved little sister... 
In short, he seduced his own daughter. Incest for incest! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE079628.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
丈夫在海外工作期间，亲生儿子与他的妻子发生关系，给丈夫戴了绿帽。
丈夫将目光转向儿子心爱的妹妹……

简而言之，他诱惑了自己的女儿。以乱伦报复乱伦！

（来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE079628.html]DLsite English[/url]）
